editorial:
If you love gritty British crime thrillers with bone-crunching action, this one is right up your alley. You follow Cain Burgess, a small-time crook who gets a temporary prison release and immediately goes rogue. Instead of reporting back, he heads straight to his old neighborhood to settle scores with the people who ruined his life. The vibe is dark, raw, and unapologetic, with a lead character who looks like he has been through hell and back. Scott Adkins brings a fierce, physical energy that makes you believe every punch and every scar.

The standout here is the action. The fight scenes are brutal, well-choreographed, and surprisingly creative for a low-budget film. The pacing keeps you locked in, and the story unfolds through flashbacks that slowly reveal how Cain became so hardened. On the downside, the dialogue can feel a bit rough around the edges, and some side characters are not very memorable. Still, if you enjoy no-nonsense action movies with a revenge plot, you will have a great time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Cain storms the pub where his brother Lincoln and his crew are hiding. After a brutal showdown, he kills Lincoln and the men who betrayed him. The twist is that Cain never planned to survive. He wanted to make sure everyone who turned him into a killer paid the price. As police arrive, Cain sits down calmly, finally at peace, knowing his revenge is complete and his nightmare is over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves hard-hitting revenge stories with intense fight scenes.
